findings.claim: REQ-03-009 needs a bound the design system's DateRangePicker cannot express, and the bundle's DS-gaps table records only three custom properties while asserting that every new value is one of them

witness.detail: REQ-03-009: 'WHILE the Range window is active and a start has been armed, THE SYSTEM SHALL bound the picker so that no end more than 91 days after that start can be chosen.' In packages/ds/src/components/forms/DateRangePicker.tsx the armed start is private state (`const [pending, setPending] = React.useState<CalendarDate | null>(null)`, :87) and the selectable set is computed from the fixed props alone (`weeks.flat().filter(date => !!date && (!minDate || date >= minDate) && (!maxDate || date <= maxDate))`, :124-127). No prop narrows the panel after the first click, so the requirement cannot be met without changing the component. The cases file's DS gaps table lists only `--name-col`, `--day-col-min`, `--range-label-col` and the three band colours, and closes with 'No colour is written that the design system does not name, and this spec declares no @literal value: every new number is one of the three custom properties above' — which is true of the numbers and silent about the capability.

findings.suggestedFix: a DS-gaps row for the span bound. Planned as T4 regardless: one optional `maxSpanDays` prop on the component, narrowing `availableDates` only — never the minDate/maxDate that gate Calendar's month arrows — and undefined by default so the three shipped report consumers are unchanged.

findings.claim: the DS-gaps table asks for a new custom property to reserve the range label's width, and that reservation already ships under another name

witness.detail: The cases file: '`--range-label-col` — no token carries a reserved width for a variable-width label in a control row | REQ-03-015 needs one.' apps/web/app/globals.css:872-878 already declares `--range-col: 26ch` on the `.time-off-calendar` block and :886-893 applies `width: var(--range-col)` to `.time-off-calendar-range`, added by commit 595fcf6 ('fix(time-off): reserve calendar range label width so nav controls hold still (BUG-013)'), which landed after the bundle was written in e659a5b. Declaring a second property would leave two names reserving one width.

findings.suggestedFix: T5 widens the existing `--range-col` to cover the widest label the four windows now produce and records the decision in the block comment, rather than declaring a second property. The widest string the contracts file names, `28 Dec 2026 – 14 Mar 2027`, is the same length as the widest preset label BUG-013 measured.

findings.claim: the bundle both writes Edge case 1 off as an acceptable gap and calls its fixture a task this spec owes, and no numbered case consumes the fixture either way

witness.detail: Known Gaps: 'No fixture can seed more than 100 active memberships, so Edge case 1 is unreachable | It is the refusal that replaces the one being withdrawn, and it is the one state this spec most needs to see | A seeding fixture under apps/api/src/test-support/, declared as a task this spec owes in the cases file.' The cases file: 'The one `no` is a task this spec owes: a seeding fixture for the over-100 case.' A gap listed as acceptable now and a task the spec owes are different obligations, and neither TC-03-INT-21…24 nor any E2E case names the fixture — so building it as written produces a file with no reader, which is what the review stage blocks on.
